name: role-os-interview
description: ShiftOS Session 5 homework. Install, then run the /role-os-interview slash command to launch a guided interview that extracts your seat expertise into two files: a Role Master Prompt (what you own, how your week really works, what good looks like) and a Unique Abilities map (your judgment, organized so an agent knows what to draft, what to flag, and what to leave to you). Re-run the command anytime and it will offer to update your existing Role OS instead of starting over.
